name: Zach Yadegari
milestone_by_age_26: Co-founded and launched Cal AI, an AI-powered calorie-tracking app, in May 2024 at age 17, growing it to over $30M in annual revenue and 10+ million downloads within 18 months, culminating in acquisition by MyFitnessPal in December 2025.
early_history_summary: Born in 2007 and raised in Roslyn, New York, Yadegari began coding at age 7 after begging his mother to enroll him in a coding camp. He taught coding lessons for $30/hour at age 10, built his first app (Speed Soccer) at 12, and created Totally Science, an unblocked gaming website that reached 5 million users and sold for $100,000 at age 16. He co-founded Cal AI in May 2024 with Henry Langmack and Blake Anderson, scaling it to $30M ARR with zero venture funding before selling to MyFitnessPal.
family_context_summary: Not documented in reviewed sources beyond references to his mother enrolling him in coding camp at age 7. No evidence of family wealth or tech industry connections.
parent_family_domain_summary: Not documented in reviewed sources; no evidence of parental tech or business domain expertise.

evidence_summary: Yadegari started coding at 7, built and sold his first app at 16 for $100K, and co-founded Cal AI at 17, scaling it to $30M ARR with zero funding before selling to MyFitnessPal. His complementary co-founder team (Blake Anderson for app expertise, Henry Langmack for engineering) was critical. He rode the AI/LLM wave for consumer apps and leveraged direct personal domain exposure (fitness tracking). Family background is largely undocumented beyond his mother supporting early coding camp enrollment. His early start in coding and app development before age 20 provided significant prior reps.
starting_point: Born in 2007 in Roslyn, New York; family background not documented beyond mother enrolling him in coding camp at age 7.
current_position: Co-founder and CEO of Cal AI; app acquired by MyFitnessPal in December 2025 for undisclosed terms; now attending University of Miami while retained at Cal AI; Forbes 30 Under 30.
